evals.prompt: Initialize a new Saudi NDS UI project using Vite 8, React 19, and Tailwind v4 in RTL mode with DGA green theme tokens.
evals.expected_output: Project configured with Vite 8, components.json registries mapping @dga, src/styles/globals.css importing tokens.css, and IBM Plex Sans Arabic font.

evals.prompt: Add the SaudiRiyalSymbol component to a product pricing card component.
evals.expected_output: Imports SaudiRiyalSymbol from '@/components/ui/saudi-riyal-symbol' and renders it alongside monetary values instead of text 'ر.س'.

evals.prompt: Build an Area Chart displaying monthly Saudi digital government service usage using NDS chart colors.
evals.expected_output: Imports ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent from '@/components/ui/chart' and configures Recharts AreaChart with --chart-1 and --chart-2 colors.
